3. **Python for Data Science** by IBM on Coursera: This course focuses on Python programming skills for data science and AI applications. It includes video lectures, auto-graded assignments, and no mandatory attendance. (Duration: 4 weeks, Effort: 2-3 hours/week)
4. **Deep Learning** by deeplearning.ai on Coursera: This course provides an introduction to deep learning, including convolutional and recurrent neural networks. It features video lectures, auto-graded assignments, and no mandatory attendance. (Duration: 4 weeks, Effort: 2-3 hours/week)

* Allocating 10-12 hours per week for course work
* Actively participating in discussion forums to clarify doubts and learn from peers

* Reviewing course materials regularly to reinforce understanding
